HEXAGHOST-CRUSHING_GHOSTFLAME.descriptio:

HEXAGHOST-INFERNO_GHOSTFLAME.title: Inferno Ghostflame
HEXAGHOST-INFERNO_GHOSTFLAME.description:
[b]To Ignite:[/b]
- Spend {energyPrefix:energyIcons(3)}.

[b]When Ignited:[/b]
- Deal {Damage:diff()} damage for each [gold]Ignited[/gold] Ghostflame.
- If all Ghostflames are [gold]Ignited[/gold], gain {IntensityPower:diff()} [gold]Intensity[/gold].
- [gold]Extinguish[/gold] all other Ghostflames. 

[b]End of Turn:[/b]
- [gold]Extinguishes[/gold] itself.
